title: Mesopotamia Song | Grade 3 History for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti and travel back to Mesopotamia, the land between the rivers! Learn about the Tigris and Euphrates, some of the first cities built with mud bricks, cuneiform writing pressed into clay tablets, the wheel, the plough and the ziggurat. Then shout the answers in the quiz.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.com/class-3-history-mesopotamia-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 The song
0:12 Land between the rivers
0:29 Sing along

1:22 Mesopotamia and the Indus Valley

2:47 Sing along

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.com
